entries.heading: No more than 20 percent of the appropriations in this
ancestors: DIVISION C—-DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
entries.text:
Sec. 8004.  No more than 20 percent of the appropriations in this 
Act which are limited for obligation during the current fiscal year 
shall be obligated during the last 2 months of the fiscal year:  
Provided, That this section shall not apply to obligations for support 
of active duty training of reserve components or summer camp training of 
the Reserve Officers' Training Corps.

                           (transfer of funds)
